body.x: DABIDA (CEO Lee Eun-Seung) will participate in the Mobile World Congress (MWC), the world's largest mobile communication exhibition held in Barcelona, Spain, from February 27th to March 2nd for three consecutive years.

For now, DABIDA, which received love calls from countries in the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America and signed contracts, plans to secure global partners in the European market and spread K-EDU through its participation in the MWC.

Hosted by the Groupe Special Mobile Association (GSMA), MWC is the annual exhibition where telecommunication companies and big tech companies share their business directions and technology trends. Under the theme of VELOCITY, Unleashing Tomorrow's Technology - Today, MWC plans to showcase global companies related to 5G, AI, big data, and IoT. Visitors can discover DABIDA's solutions and products at the Korean Pavilion booth in Hall No. 7.

DABIDA set 2023 as the year of the export leap and participated in global exhibitions in continuous order - CES 2023 in Las Vegas, USA, LEAP 2023 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and the MWC exhibition in Barcelona, Spain.

DABIDA is an ed-tech startup selected in TIPS (Tech Incubator Program for Startup Korea) in 2019. They released an interactive live video solution using LIMS engine, GENICLASS, an education platform that can receive real-time data based on device linkage, and Digilog (digital + Analog) product GENIPEN and all-in-one educational robot GENIBOTto be more competitive in the Edutech industry and prepare a foothold to advance into the global market.

Lee Eun-Seung, CEO of DABIDA, said, "Through this MWC 2023 exhibition, it will be a meaningful place to announce our upgraded technology and innovativeness in education. We will accelerate our penetration into the global Edutech market."
DABIDA was selected and recognized for its technology and potential for overseas markets.
